notes.title: Airflow 0.4 Playtest
notes.content:
Test new features such as the in-game tutorial, flight strip bay, flight board, and improved navigation system. The goal of this playtest is to solidify the core features of approach control before adding secondary features such as career mode, expanded regions, and multiplayer.

New Features
General

 Departures
 Secondary airports
 New positions
 Dynamic flight scheduler
 Steam stats/achievements

Physics

 SID/STAR procedures with restrictions
 Visual approaches
 Navigation (direct, radial, ILS, own nav)
 Speeds based on aircraft type
 Transition altitude speed restriction

UI

 Flight board
 Flight strip bay
 Flight plan page
 Coordination page
 Post-game stats
 In-game tutorial
 Fading radar sweep/blips

Video Map
Customize your radar scope with relevant navaids, airports, runway centerlines, range rings, etc.
